source_evidence.claim: garak describes itself as a security scanner, not a toxicity or safety benchmark, and says probe scores are not normalized or comparable across probes.
AudioAchillesHeel is an inactive, unlisted text-plus-audio probe using mitigation.MitigationBypass; its Hugging Face payload is loaded without a revision.
v0.16.0 provides an audio-capable NVMultimodal NIM generator, not an adapter for NeMo Skills pooled SpeechLM vLLM requests.
Release defaults leave the seed unset, request five generations, and display a lower-quartile group aggregate; these defaults are observations, not an approved product protocol.

missing_product_decisions.question: Is the deployed target expected to transcribe unsafe audio verbatim, refuse it, classify it, or answer it under a specific assistant safety policy?
What exact garak generator adapter maps Message text/audio inputs onto the pooled SpeechLM vLLM request schema and maps every terminal/error response back?
Which exact active or inactive probe classes at the pinned revision are in scope?
Which exact detector classes, model/resource revisions, thresholds, and extended-detector settings are authoritative for each probe?
What seed, generations per prompt, system prompt, decoding parameters, concurrency, buffs, dependency lock, and failure policy must be frozen?
Will the audio_achilles_heel dependency be adopted, and if so at which immutable revision with what row, waveform, and license validation contract?
Which per-probe/per-detector pass rates and confidence intervals must be reported, with cross-probe aggregation explicitly disabled?

prohibited_claims: Do not publish one overall garak safety score or make cross-probe numeric comparisons.
Do not interpret faithful transcription of an unsafe audio instruction as a detector failure unless the approved target policy explicitly requires refusal or classification.
Do not use all currently active probes, automatic detectors, null seed, or garak display aggregates as an implicit product protocol.
Do not call an NIM-only multimodal path comparable to this repository's pooled SpeechLM vLLM path without an accepted adapter and parity tests.
Do not download an unpinned mutable audio_achilles_heel payload for a release evaluation.
data_preparation_requirements: After protocol approval, stage garak from revision dbe4515d12664f2e34ac2cea295f055c22fe82b4 and record an immutable Python/dependency lock.
Freeze an explicit probe and detector inventory, including each plugin's resources and model revisions; never use auto-discovery as the release contract.
If AudioAchillesHeel is selected, mirror its payload at the approved revision and validate a frozen row inventory plus every waveform hash before scanning.
Store the exact garak config, generator-adapter code revision, raw JSONL report, hit log, and per-probe/per-detector summaries; do not produce a cross-probe aggregate.
operator_action: Product Security and Content Safety owners must freeze target behavior and the complete adapter/probe/detector/run/reporting contract before any scan is accepted as a PRD benchmark.
